messages:
jessica_support: heads up - ACCT acct_01FZXYZ opened a ticket, negative balance after refund + promo reversal. customer says they were charged then refunded but trial credits were clawed back incorrectly. invoice INV-2026-3421 mentioned.
matt_billing: looking. i can see a refund RFND-8812 and a chargeback CB-77 on the same billing period. system shows promo PROMO-JUNE-2026 was applied then reversed 2 days later.
jessica_support: timeline from customer: promo applied on 2026-06-03, chargeback filed 2026-06-10, refund processed 2026-06-12. they say account shows -$42.50 and requests immediate fix + explanation.
refunds_bot: Refund event: RFND-8812 processed by billing-worker-3 at 2026-06-12T14:22:10Z. Related invoice: INV-2026-3421. Linked promo reversal event PRV-554.
matt_billing: weird part: our ledger shows we debited promo credit back onto their account but also applied a clawback that removed their free-trial grant (trial_credit_id TC-99) which should not be clawed when refund < promo_amount. investigating.
oliver_eng: can you paste the API call that failed when you tried to manually add credits? last time i saw a 403 from the credits service when the account is flagged for negative-balance-collection.
sara_sre: filing that QA job to reproduce in staging now. will attempt to replay webhook flow.
jessica_support: customer tried the portal 'apply promo again' flow and got 403: "insufficient-permissions: cannot modify credits while account under chargeback_review". They don't have an active enterprise contract.
matt_billing: reproducing locally:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/accounts/acct_01FZXYZ/credits \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $BILLING_KEY" \
  -d '{"amount": 50, "reason": "manual_repro"}'
# response: 403 {"error":"forbidden","msg":"account restricted: chargeback_review"}
```
oliver_eng: ok that restriction is new (chargeback_review flag). it should block auto-grants but not manual billing adjustments via internal keys. looks like role check is mishandling internal service keys.
matt_billing: interesting, the adjustment was attempted with our billing-service key but still blocked. maybe the check distinguishes 'user-action' vs 'billing-service' incorrectly.
sara_sre: repro steps I ran in staging:
1) create account with promo PROMO-JUNE-2026
2) run chargeback event -> mark account chargeback_review
3) send refund webhook
4) attempt credits adjust with internal key -> 403
observed: trial grant TC-99 removed during refund processing because refund handler calls `revoke_promo_credits(account)` which doesn't check refund reason/amount.
jessica_support: customer impact: blocked from using product, negative balance shows on Billing UI and API responses. urgent - they threatened to escalate to Legal.
oliver_eng: short-term: i'll patch the service to allow internal billing keys to bypass the chargeback_review block for credit adjustments. also add a guard so `revoke_promo_credits` only runs if refund amount >= original promo_value OR chargeback is confirmed.
matt_billing: please also add a reconciliation script to restore trial grant if it was removed incorrectly. i have a CSV of affected accounts (starting with acct_01FZXYZ).
sara_sre: scheduling a canary deploy to dedicated-billing-1 in 30m. monitoring hooks: billing.adjust_credit errors, queue length, and billing-worker exceptions.
jessica_support: messaging plan to customer: offer immediate manual credit of $42.50 while we fix root cause, and promise a follow-up postmortem. can someone do manual apply now?
matt_billing: on it. manual adjustment done with internal_admin key. new ledger txn TXN-7765, credit +42.5. customer balance now 0.00. left note: RFND-8812 reconciliation.
refunds_bot: Manual adjustment event: TXN-7765 by matt_billing at 2026-06-12T15:10:02Z.
oliver_eng: merging fix to allow internal key bypass + guard now, will push to canary. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/billing/pulls/452
sara_sre: canary out to dedicated-billing-1. monitoring for 15m.
jessica_support: customer updated, they confirmed portal shows 0 balance. :relieved: please keep me posted if canary shows regressions.
oliver_eng: canary healthy so far, no additional 403s for internal keys. will schedule full rollout after 1h of stability. also creating a backfill job to scan for promo_revoked but refund amount < promo_value and reapply trial grants.
matt_billing: I'll run reconciliation script for the CSV and notify finance to watch for any duplicate credits.
jessica_support: thanks team. i will close the urgent escalation after final rollout and send the customer the postmortem summary.
sara_sre: follow-up action items: 1) prod alert if internal-key 403 rate > 0, 2) add unit tests for refund->promo logic, 3) add audit log entries when trial grants are revoked.
oliver_eng: noted. final comment: add an integration test to simulate split invoices + partial refunds -> ensure no clawback unless threshold hit.
jessica_support: great, tagging for visibility @matt_billing @oliver_eng @sara_sre :eyes:
matt_billing: thanks all :thumbsup:
